item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President states the order’s purpose and offers ceremonial recognition; the segment directs no agency action and creates no legal consequence.","evidence":"America honors the extraordinary service rendered to the United States by veterans with disabilities incurred or aggravated in the line of duty during active service with the armed forces."},{"segment_id":"2","code":4,"rationale":"The segment inseparably combines mandatory internal planning, reporting, staffing, training, and assistance with a direction to the GSA Administrator to later establish a government-wide contract legally reserved for specified businesses.","evidence":"establish a Government-wide Acquisition Contract reserved for participation by service-disabled veteran businesses"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The Secretaries must provide administrative assistance and education, while the definitions delimit the order’s internal operation; no substantive legal consequence is presently imposed or dictated for later imposition.","evidence":"shall assist agencies by making available services of the CVE"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"Agencies receive implementation constraints and discretionary instructions concerning interagency information sharing and commission compliance; the segment also disclaims enforceable rights rather than creating them.","evidence":"shall implement this order to the extent it determines appropriate to the accomplishment of the agency's mission"}]}
